verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim Devin can 'repro and fix bugs' (devin-docs-1), use Ask Devin/DeepWiki to narrow root causes via codebase understanding (devin-docs-15, devin-docs-16, devin-docs-27), and verify fixes through CI iteration/Auto-Fix loops (devin-docs-18). However, hands-on community testimony reports Devin often adds extraneous changes beyond the task scope and cannot reliably undo them when asked, undermining clean verification of fixes (devin-comm-1), and lacks an escape hatch when stuck on root-cause diagnosis (devin-comm-2, devin-comm-3). Missing for 10: independent verification of successful bug reproduction/root-cause narrowing at scale, and resolution of the reported inability to cleanly revert unwanted changes during fix verification.
